messages.en: I want
to Y/n,
to show you every side of me.
Although... I think I've already shown you quite a lot...
Then can I show you everything about me too?
Go ahead, show me.
So from now on I can burp and stuff, right?
Why would you do that? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Fine. ㅡㅡㅡ *Burp.*
May I leave? I think it smells in here.
Hayeon doesn't do things like that.
Yep, I don't.
I don't do anything.
I'm a fairy, remember?~
Even eating food,
I only do it
to pretend I'm human.
It's actually really hard for me to eat. ㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 그런 거 치곤 너무 잘 먹던데
messages.en: You say that, but you eat way too well for that.
Shh.

messages.ko: 나사실 아주 작지만 강력한 날개도 있어서
messages.en: Actually, I have very tiny but powerful wings too.
I'm always nervous that I might suddenly fly away.
Like, 'Uh-oh, I'm about to take off.'
I still can't control them because I'm still just a baby.
Once I become an adult, I'll be able to control them.
